notes: The marginal note *Or, better than they both is he that etc.* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
*did I esteem* is italic in the ASV and answers to no morpheme, so it is added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause rather than folded into `טוֹב`, which already holds *better*.
`מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם` is split: `מִן` takes *than*, the construct numeral *both*, and the suffix *them* (rules 19, 30's subtraction test).
`הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הָרָע` → *the evil work* gives the single written *the* to the noun's own article, the agreement article being unrepresented (rule 47).
